name: Cheese Souffle (Variation 2)
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Mix together in a saucepan 1 ounce melted butter and 1 tablespoon flour
When quite smooth, add 1 teaspoon salt and a pinch pepper and 1 cup milk
Cook and stir this till thick as good cream
Remove from stove and beat in ¾ cup grated cheese and yolks of 2 eggs
Beat in lightly the stiffly beaten whites of the eggs
Pour the mixture into a buttered pudding dish
Bake in a very hot oven for about 25 minutes
Serve as soon as taken from oven

source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix together in a saucepan 1 ounce melted butter and 1 tablespoon flour
2. When quite smooth, add 1 teaspoon salt and a pinch pepper and 1 cup milk
3. Cook and stir this till thick as good cream
4. Remove from stove and beat in ¾ cup grated cheese and yolks of 2 eggs
5. Beat in lightly the stiffly beaten whites of the eggs
6. Pour the mixture into a buttered pudding dish
7. Bake in a very hot oven for about 25 minutes
8. Serve as soon as taken from oven
